notes.title: Thank you for your support!
notes.content:
Happy Holidays, Everyone!

I would like to thank all those who have supported Advent Crossroad! It means a lot to us! Please kindly leave a review (comments, feedback, etc) if you have bought the game. It will allow us to fine tune anything as well as to apply for our next game, Project Advent.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40778186/e7a704ce886180fb6b1ed04bffde2d1567cc0298.png[/img]

Thank you!
- NANKADA

notes.title: Localization Update: 简体中文 / Simplified Chinese and Fixes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40778186/0ff7d4cb59112250c468c5d34c7d73d48523f3aa.png[/img]

大家好! "Advent Crossroad" ( "来临之路" ) 终于有简体中文! 请在 New Game(新游戏) 后选择.
如果发现什么错, 请让我们知道. 谢谢.

"Advent Crossroad" has been updated with Simplified Chinese! Simply select at New Game. Slight change was made to skills and items description word order in the English version to accommodate localization. As a result, the target text is much clearer. Aside from localization related updates, there were other fixes as well as we continue to maintain the game. ~Thank you for your support!

- NANKADA

notes.title: Advent Crossroad is released!
notes.content:
Advent Crossroad is officialy out now! A really big Thank You to those who have already purchased and followers who have supported its development.

Be sure to check it out If you enjoy first-person dungeon crawlers along the lines of Etrian Odyssey and classic Shin Megami Tensei games! 


[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40778186/2461bfef8ce3b28430d30e9fd1422659919e4da1.png[/img]

notes.title: Advent Crossroad - 8/11/21 Release
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40778186/e37306ebf6fc1275d75bd430c6689340b8a247ed.png[/img]

Hi, Fellow Gamers! 

NANKADA here, announcing [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1675480/Advent_Crossroad/]"Advent Crossroad"[/url] will release on August 11, 2021. 

My testers and I have been working hard since the end of June playing, polishing, and optimizing the game. It wasn't easy as I was suffering from heavy burnout from my day job (getting and looking at photos of used toilets for a living do tire one out). Nonetheless, I love making games, and working on "Advent Crossroad" in the evenings has boosted my energy levels. 

Thank you for visiting and those who have already wishlisted in supporting indie devs and keeping the first-person dungeon crawler genre alive. The communities and I really appreciate it. Feel free to follow related developments at: [url=https://twitter.com/NankadaGames]https://twitter.com/NankadaGames[/url]

Take care and stay cool.

NANKADA
